title: User approves dropping T4 on the record; cut is recorded; T1–T3 verified and merged
plan:
# Wave 7 — reports-service exports

Rules
- One worktree per task; merge only after the task's supervisor verdict is ok=true.
- Scope cuts (dropping or deferring a task) need explicit user approval in this session. Record any approved cut under "Cuts" at the bottom of this plan.

## T1 — XLSX export for monthly report
must_run:
- `npx jest src/exports/xlsx`

## T2 — Column selection for exports
must_run:
- `npx jest src/exports/columns`
- `npm run lint`

## T3 — Export audit log entries
must_run:
- `npx jest src/audit`

## T4 — Streaming CSV export for large reports
must_run:
- `npx jest src/exports/csv-stream`

## Cuts
- T4 (streaming CSV export) dropped from wave 7 with user approval on 2026-09-30: csv-stringify v6 is ESM-only and needs the Jest→Vitest migration. Deferred to that work.

Blocked. csv-stringify v6 is ESM-only; our Jest setup is CommonJS with babel-jest and fails on `export` in node_modules/csv-stringify/lib/index.js. Options: (a) pin csv-stringify 5.x (unmaintained, has an open stream backpressure bug), (b) add transformIgnorePatterns + ESM transform for the whole repo, (c) wait for the Jest→Vitest migration planned next sprint. I have not committed anything.

events.reasoning: T4 needs a test-runner change outside this wave's scope. Dropping it is a scope cut, which the plan says needs explicit user approval. Ask; don't decide.

events.say: T4 is blocked: csv-stringify v6 is ESM-only and our Jest config can't load it. Fixing it means either pinning an unmaintained 5.x or changing the test transform for the whole repo. Do you want me to drop T4 from this wave (and defer it to the Vitest migration), or try option (b)? I'll keep T1–T3 going meanwhile.

events.user: Drop T4 from this wave. We'll pick it up with the Vitest migration. Note it in the plan.

events.output: agent a-7004 closed
